meta.name: DAGM. Y
meta.tagline: I enjoy working with businesses and creative individuals.
meta.aboutBio:
Hey, I am a WordPress developer with 3+ years building custom plugins, LMS platforms, membership systems, eCommerce stores, and sites that hold up after launch. I work with business owners who need WordPress done right the first time and maintained with the same standard after.   

Here is what that looks like in practice:  
A plugin your team actually needed, built from scratch because no off-the-shelf tool did it correctly. A LearnDash course platform that enrolls students, tracks progress, and handles payment without manual work. A site that loads fast, stays secure, and does not break when you update a plugin. A care plan that means someone with real expertise is watching your site every week, not just collecting a fee.  

My focus is clean builds, honest timelines, and sites that work the way your business needs them to.   

What I help with:  
- Custom WordPress Plugin Development  
- LearnDash LMS Builds and Customization  
- MemberPress and Membership System Setup  
- WooCommerce Development and Configuration  
- WordPress Web Design (Elementor, custom themes)  
- Website Care Plans and Ongoing Maintenance  
- Plugin Debugging and Conflict Resolution  
- Site Speed and Performance Optimization  
- WordPress Migration and Security Hardening  
- Gravity Forms, API Integrations, and Custom Workflows  

Tools and platforms I know well: WordPress, LearnDash, MemberPress, WooCommerce, Gravity Forms, Elementor, Advanced Custom Fields, PHP, MySQL, Divi, Gutenburg, Wp Page Bakery, REST API, Stripe, Zapier, Cloudflare.  

My approach is simple. I look at what your site needs to do for your business. Then I build it to do exactly that. No overcomplicated solutions. No disappearing after launch.   

If you need a plugin built, a course platform launched, or a developer who will actually keep your site healthy, send me a message.
meta.specialization: Specializing in fast, mobile-responsive, SEO-friendly websites that drive results.

projects.title: MeskelPay
projects.caseStudy: Built a modern payment platform from scratch using Next.js 16 and React 19 with a custom WooCommerce plugin for seamless e-commerce integration. Architected the database layer with Neon Postgres and Drizzle ORM for type-safe queries. The platform handles real-time transaction processing with a clean, responsive UI.

projects.title: JB Dondolo
projects.caseStudy: Designed and developed a nonprofit website with WooCommerce integration for donations and merchandise. Implemented LiteSpeed caching for fast load times on shared hosting. Custom Divi layouts gave the organization a professional, trustworthy presence without ongoing developer costs.

projects.title: Syndicore Media
projects.caseStudy: Created a fully custom WordPress theme with bespoke Elementor widgets for a media agency. Built interactive portfolio showcases using vanilla JS animations. Configured Nginx server for optimal performance. The site loads under 2 seconds and scored 95+ on Lighthouse.

projects.title: Heron Dance
projects.caseStudy: Redesigned an existing Squarespace site for a dance organization with custom CSS overrides for a unique visual identity. Implemented fluid responsive layouts that adapt beautifully across all devices. Maintained the client's ability to edit content independently through Squarespace's editor.

projects.title: Lonestar Peptides
projects.caseStudy: Built a full WooCommerce store for a peptide research company with wholesale pricing tiers, age verification gate, and custom payment gateway integrations. Developed a child theme for safe customizations. Implemented bulk pricing rules and age-gated access to comply with industry regulations.

projects.title: True Light Pools
projects.caseStudy: Delivered a polished pool service website on Squarespace with custom CSS for a premium feel. Created a service-focused layout with clear CTAs and mobile-first responsive design. The site emphasizes trust signals and local SEO to drive service inquiries.

projects.title: BPS Pools
projects.caseStudy: Developed a high-performance pool services site using Astra Pro and Elementor Pro with Ultimate Addons for advanced widgets. Configured Breeze caching and Smush Pro for image optimization. Achieved sub-3-second load times with a visually rich, conversion-focused design.

projects.title: The Arch International
projects.caseStudy: Built a corporate website for an international consulting firm using Elementor Pro with the lightweight Hello theme. Integrated Tablesome for structured data presentation and custom form workflows. Hosted on Hostinger with optimized PHP settings for fast TTFB.

projects.title: Rose Bookshop
projects.caseStudy: Developed an online bookstore with WooCommerce on the ChapterOne theme, featuring WPBakery page builder and Slider Revolution for engaging hero sections. Integrated Mailchimp for WooCommerce for email marketing automation. Customized product pages for book browsing with filters and search.
